s0401.literal: On gengxu day, Tutuhe's grandsons were forbidden to search and seize private goods of relay travelers.
s0401.idiomatic: On gengxu day Tutuhe's grandsons were forbidden to search relay travelers for private goods.

s0402.literal: On yimao day, officials were established at Yingchang Prefecture according to precedent.
s0402.idiomatic: On yimao day officials were established at Yingchang Prefecture according to precedent.

s0403.literal: The Eastern Palace guard army was established.
s0403.idiomatic: The Eastern Palace guard army was established.

s0404.literal: It was fixed that two darughachi were to be placed in Jiangnan upper and middle circuits, and one in lower circuits.
s0404.idiomatic: It was fixed that Jiangnan upper and middle circuits would have two darughachi each and lower circuits one each.

s0405.literal: An edict dispatched seven thousand Mongol troops of Western Sichuan and three thousand newly submitted troops to Prince Anxi Wang.
s0405.idiomatic: An edict dispatched seven thousand Western Sichuan Mongol troops and three thousand newly submitted troops to Prince Anxi Wang.

s0406.literal: On dingsi day, Jiaozhi sent envoys to present tribute of tame elephants.
s0406.idiomatic: On dingsi day Jiaozhi sent envoys to present tame elephants as tribute.

s0407.literal: On jiwei day, the city of Samudo in Duogemasi territory was made Zhenxi Prefecture.
s0407.idiomatic: On jiwei day Samudo in Duogemasi territory was made Zhenxi Prefecture.

s0408.literal: An edict ordered two thousand Mongol troops, two thousand Yidu troops, one thousand troops from various routes, and five thousand newly submitted troops — ten thousand in all — to be placed under Li Ting's command.
s0408.idiomatic: An edict ordered two thousand Mongol troops, two thousand Yidu troops, one thousand troops from various routes, and five thousand newly submitted troops — ten thousand in all — under Li Ting's command.

s0409.literal: On renxu day, Önggüd troops who fought hard were rewarded fifty taels of silver each; those killed in action received one hundred taels each, given to their families.
s0409.idiomatic: On renxu day Önggüd troops who fought hard were rewarded fifty taels of silver each; the families of those killed in action received one hundred taels each.

s0410.literal: Ala Haiya came to audience and presented three thousand five hundred eighty taels of gold and fifty-three thousand one hundred taels of silver.
s0410.idiomatic: Ala Haiya came to audience and presented 3,580 taels of gold and 53,100 taels of silver.

s0411.literal: The Tanzhou Branch Secretariat's construction of warships for campaigns against Japan and Jiaozhi was abolished.
s0411.idiomatic: The Tanzhou Branch Secretariat was ordered to stop building warships for campaigns against Japan and Jiaozhi.

s0412.literal: On bingyin day, Saturn encroached upon Jianbi.
s0412.idiomatic: On bingyin day Saturn encroached upon Jianbi.

s0413.literal: On guiyou day, the Southwestern Eight Fan, the Luo clan country, and others submitted — one thousand six hundred twenty-six cave stockades in all, one hundred one thousand one hundred sixty-eight households in all.
s0413.idiomatic: On guiyou day the Southwestern Eight Fan, the Luo clan country, and others submitted — 1,626 cave stockades and 101,168 households in all.

s0414.literal: An edict dispatched Yanash and Cui Yu to Jiangnan to seek out persons skilled in arts and techniques.
s0414.idiomatic: An edict sent Yanash and Cui Yu to Jiangnan to seek out persons skilled in arts and techniques.

s0415.literal: Left censor of the Central Secretariat and acting Sichuan Branch Secretariat director Wang Liangchen was made chancellor to Prince Anxi Wang.
s0415.idiomatic: Central Secretariat left censor and acting Sichuan Branch Secretariat director Wang Liangchen was made chancellor to Prince Anxi Wang.

s0416.literal: Officers and commanders with merit under Prince Narihu were granted silver, notes, clothing, silks and cloth, sheep and horses in graded amounts.
s0416.idiomatic: Officers and commanders with merit under Prince Narihu received silver, notes, clothing, silks and cloth, sheep, and horses in graded amounts.

s0417.literal: Because of flood and drought at Zhao Prefecture and other places, this year's land tax was reduced by three thousand one hundred eighty-one shi.
s0417.idiomatic: Because of flood and drought at Zhao Prefecture and other places, this year's land tax was reduced by 3,181 shi.

s0418.literal: Sando was ordered to perform Buddhist rites for fifteen days.
s0418.idiomatic: Sando was ordered to perform Buddhist rites for fifteen days.

s0419.literal: Eighth month, dingchou day: the imperial carriage arrived from Shangdu.
s0419.idiomatic: Eighth month, dingchou day: the imperial carriage arrived from Shangdu.

s0420.literal: On gengchen day, the moon occulted the determining star of the Room.
s0420.idiomatic: On gengchen day the moon occulted the determining star of the Room.

s0421.literal: On wuzi day, Fan Wenhu said: "Your subject, bearing the edict to campaign against Japan, recently sent Zhou Fu, Luan Zhong, and a Japanese monk bearing the edict to instruct that country; they are expected to return with a report in the fourth month of next year — only after learning whether they consent should troops be sent."
s0421.idiomatic: On wuzi day Fan Wenhu said: "Your subject, under orders to campaign against Japan, recently sent Zhou Fu, Luan Zhong, and a Japanese monk with an edict to instruct that country; they are expected back in the fourth month of next year — only once we know whether they consent should troops advance."

s0422.literal: He also requested that old warships be inspected and used to fill needs.
s0422.idiomatic: He also asked that old warships be inspected and put to use.

s0424.literal: The sea bandit He Wenda led his followers to submit to Wenhu; Wenhu presented the three thousand taels of silver he had obtained.
s0424.idiomatic: The sea bandit He Wenda led his followers to submit to Fan Wenhu, who presented the three thousand taels of silver he had obtained.

s0425.literal: An imperial directive pardoned his earlier crimes, appointed forty-eight of his followers to office, and granted the silver to Wenhu as a gift.
s0425.idiomatic: An imperial directive pardoned his earlier crimes, appointed forty-eight of his followers to office, and granted the silver to Wenhu.

s0426.literal: On jichou day, Song submitted subject Wang Huchen presented seventeen practical proposals; Zhang Yi and others were ordered to deliberate — those deemed feasible were implemented.
s0426.idiomatic: On jichou day Song submitted subject Wang Huchen presented seventeen practical proposals; Zhang Yi and others were ordered to deliberate, and feasible ones were implemented.

s0427.literal: On gengyin day, an edict ordered Qadagh, Mongol troops chief controller of Yuanzhou Circuit, to subdue the unsubmitted barbarians of Tongmulong, Gelao, Bodong, and others.
s0427.idiomatic: On gengyin day an edict ordered Qadagh, Mongol troops chief controller of Yuanzhou Circuit, to subdue the unsubmitted barbarians of Tongmulong, Gelao, Bodong, and others.

s0428.literal: Five thousand newly submitted troops from Jiangnan were transferred to garrison at Taiyuan; five thousand at Daming; five thousand at Weizhou.
s0428.idiomatic: Five thousand newly submitted Jiangnan troops were posted at Taiyuan, five thousand at Daming, and five thousand at Weizhou.

s0429.literal: Because ceremonial expenses for the annual birthday and personal fortune day were all levied on the people, an edict ordered this abolished throughout the realm.
s0429.idiomatic: Because ceremonial expenses for the annual birthday and personal fortune day were levied on the people, an edict abolished the practice throughout the realm.

s0430.literal: On dingyou day, forty-nine jade goblets and stands captured in Jiangnan were deposited in the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
s0430.idiomatic: On dingyou day forty-nine jade goblets and stands captured in Jiangnan were deposited in the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

s0431.literal: On jihai day, the sea bandit Jin Tongjing died; his nephew Wen was captured. The officials wished to punish according to law. The emperor said: "Tongjing is already dead — what has Wen to do with it?"
s0431.idiomatic: On jihai day the sea bandit Jin Tongjing died and his nephew Wen was captured; the officials wished to punish him by law. The emperor said: "Tongjing is already dead — what has Wen to do with it?"

s0433.literal: On gengzi day, Jupiter encroached on the great star of Xuanyuan.
s0433.idiomatic: On gengzi day Jupiter encroached on the great star of Xuanyuan.

s0434.literal: On jiachen day, an edict: Han troops who fled on campaign were sentenced to death, and their families confiscated.
s0434.idiomatic: On jiachen day an edict ordered that Han troops who fled on campaign be sentenced to death and their families confiscated.

s0435.literal: The Chief Directorate of the Great State-Protecting Benevolent Kings Temple was established, with Sanjar as darughachi and Li Guangzu as director-general.
s0435.idiomatic: The Chief Directorate of the Great State-Protecting Benevolent Kings Temple was established, with Sanjar as darughachi and Li Guangzu as director-general.

s0436.literal: Twenty-one members of Fan Wenhu's staff were granted gold-patterned gauze and Western brocade clothing.
s0436.idiomatic: Twenty-one members of Fan Wenhu's staff received gold-patterned gauze and Western brocade clothing.

s0437.literal: Officers and commanders of the Chongqing campaign were rewarded with silks and cloth in graded amounts.
s0437.idiomatic: Officers and commanders of the Chongqing campaign were rewarded with silks and cloth in graded amounts.

s0438.literal: Prince Ajiji was granted five thousand shi of grain, six hundred horses, and ten thousand sheep.
s0438.idiomatic: Prince Ajiji received five thousand shi of grain, six hundred horses, and ten thousand sheep.

s0439.literal: Ninth month, yisi day, first of the month: Fan Wenhu recommended thirty persons suitable to serve as prefects and magistrates.
s0439.idiomatic: Ninth month, yisi day, first of the month: Fan Wenhu recommended thirty persons suitable to serve as prefects and magistrates.

s0440.literal: An edict: "Recommendations hereafter — I shall choose among them myself.
s0440.idiomatic: An edict: "Recommendations hereafter — I shall choose among them myself.

s0441.literal: Any official who is negligent in his duties, whether Han or Muslim, shall be executed, and his family confiscated."
s0441.idiomatic: Any official negligent in his duties, whether Han or Muslim, shall be executed and his family confiscated."

s0442.literal: Female Jurchen and Udege troops who do not go on campaign are ordered to be registered as civilian households and pay taxes.
s0442.idiomatic: Female Jurchen and Udege troops who do not go on campaign are ordered to be registered as civilian households and pay taxes.

s0443.literal: On jiyou day, the thousand ship-guard troops at Jin Prefecture were abolished; a measured number kept for supervision, the rest all sent home.
s0443.idiomatic: On jiyou day the thousand ship-guard troops at Jin Prefecture were disbanded; a measured number were kept for supervision and the rest sent home.

s0444.literal: On gengxu day, an edict ordered left censor of the mobile Central Secretariat Husin concurrently to oversee artisans of all categories in Hangzhou and other circuits; from Hangzhou's tax revenue, one hundred thousand bolts of silk were to be manufactured annually for presentation.
s0444.idiomatic: On gengxu day an edict ordered mobile Central Secretariat left censor Husin concurrently to oversee artisans of all categories in Hangzhou and other circuits; from Hangzhou tax revenue one hundred thousand bolts of silk were to be manufactured annually for presentation.

s0445.literal: Tax-collecting officials of Hangzhou, Suzhou, and Jiaxing circuits took extra commission beyond quota; henceforth they would receive monthly food allowances; those who took more than prescribed would be punished.
s0445.idiomatic: Tax-collecting officials of Hangzhou, Suzhou, and Jiaxing circuits took extra commission beyond quota; henceforth they would receive monthly food allowances, and those who took more than prescribed would be punished.

s0446.literal: Ahmad said: "Prince Anxi's chancellery official Zhao Bing said that Shaanxi tax revenue yields nineteen thousand ingots annually; if the responsible offices truly applied themselves, forty thousand ingots could be obtained."
s0446.idiomatic: Ahmad said: "Prince Anxi's chancellery official Zhao Bing said Shaanxi tax revenue yields nineteen thousand ingots annually; if the responsible offices truly applied themselves, forty thousand ingots could be obtained."

s0447.literal: Zhao Bing was immediately ordered to take overall charge.
s0447.idiomatic: Zhao Bing was immediately ordered to take overall charge.

s0448.literal: Associate prefectural commissioner Dong Zhongwei of Yangzhou was guilty of corruption; the regional office was investigating when Zhongwei falsely accused regional officials of other matters.
s0448.idiomatic: Yangzhou associate prefectural commissioner Dong Zhongwei was guilty of corruption; while the regional office was investigating, Zhongwei falsely accused regional officials of other matters.

s0449.literal: An edict removed Zhongwei from office and confiscated two-tenths of his property.
s0449.idiomatic: An edict removed Zhongwei from office and confiscated two-tenths of his property.

s0450.literal: On wuwu day, Prince Anxi's chancellery reported: "The Sichuan Pacification Commission has seventeen thousand three hundred eight persons on the rolls without actual military service who falsely received rewards."
s0450.idiomatic: On wuwu day Prince Anxi's chancellery reported: "The Sichuan Pacification Commission has 17,308 persons on the rolls without actual military service who falsely received rewards."

s0451.literal: An order was issued to investigate and punish them.
s0451.idiomatic: An order was issued to investigate and punish them.

s0452.literal: It was deliberated to abolish Hans serving as darughachi.
s0452.idiomatic: It was deliberated to abolish Hans serving as darughachi.

s0453.literal: Censorate officials reported: "Tax officials of the three Jiangnan circuits spent one thousand nine hundred ingots of notes beyond their allotted commission."
s0453.idiomatic: Censorate officials reported: "Tax officials of the three Jiangnan circuits spent 1,900 ingots of notes beyond their allotted commission."

s0454.literal: An order was issued to recover all of it.
s0454.idiomatic: An order was issued to recover all of it.

s0455.literal: An edict dispatched envoys to summon and instruct chieftains of southwestern barbarian tribes — those who could lead their followers to submit would keep their offices and their people would not lose their livelihoods.
s0455.idiomatic: An edict dispatched envoys to summon and instruct chieftains of southwestern barbarian tribes; those who led their followers to submit would keep their offices and their people would not lose their livelihoods.

s0456.literal: On yichou day, Hubilai and Bessutai were made commander-in-chief, leading two thousand Mongol troops and one thousand Hexi troops to garrison Wandan city.
s0456.idiomatic: On yichou day Hubilai and Bessutai were made commander-in-chief, leading two thousand Mongol troops and one thousand Hexi troops to garrison Wandan city.

s0457.literal: On jisi day, Privy Council officials reported: "One Tangudai, in violation of prohibitions, led more than a thousand troops to plunder more than a thousand newly submitted persons plus cattle, horses, gold, silver, and silks at Chenxi, Yuanzhou, and other places; and Mayang County darughachi Wobuhua served as their guide."
s0457.idiomatic: On jisi day Privy Council officials reported: "Tangudai, in violation of prohibitions, led more than a thousand troops to plunder more than a thousand newly submitted persons plus cattle, horses, gold, silver, and silks at Chenxi, Yuanzhou, and other places, while Mayang County darughachi Wobuhua served as their guide."

s0458.literal: An edict ordered Tangudai and Wobuhua beheaded; the rest sentenced to reduced death; plunder was returned to the people.
s0458.idiomatic: An edict ordered Tangudai and Wobuhua beheaded; the rest received reduced death sentences, and plunder was returned to the people.

s0459.literal: Ten thousand ingots of notes were issued to the Hexi Branch Secretariat for expenses.
s0459.idiomatic: Ten thousand ingots of notes were issued to the Hexi Branch Secretariat for expenses.

s0460.literal: Winter, tenth month, jimao day: offerings were made at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
s0460.idiomatic: Winter, tenth month, jimao day: offerings were made at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

s0461.literal: On xinsi day, river relay stations were established from Xuzhou and Kuifu to the Jiangling border.
s0461.idiomatic: On xinsi day river relay stations were established from Xuzhou and Kuifu to the Jiangling border.

s0462.literal: On yiyou day, the emperor attended at the Incense Pavilion.
s0462.idiomatic: On yiyou day the emperor attended at the Incense Pavilion.

s0463.literal: Director of the Grand Music Office Wanyan Chun and others were ordered to rehearse civil and military music.
s0463.idiomatic: Grand Music Office director Wanyan Chun and others were ordered to rehearse civil and military music.

s0464.literal: On wuzi day, Zhang Rong complained that in corvée purchases and labor hires for Western Capital military households, the responsible offices concealed price notes totaling more than eighteen thousand ingots;
s0464.idiomatic: On wuzi day Zhang Rong complained that in corvée purchases and labor hires for Western Capital military households, the responsible offices concealed price notes totaling more than eighteen thousand ingots;

s0465.literal: the officials were punished; Rong was made zongba of the guard army.
s0465.idiomatic: the officials were punished and Rong was made zongba of the guard army.

s0466.literal: Qianhu Tuolüe and zongba Hudai unauthorized led troops into Yongkang county of Wuzhou, killing and plundering officials and people; when discovered, they pleaded that they had accompanied the former emperor on campaign with merit and begged commutation of death.
s0466.idiomatic: Qianhu Tuolüe and zongba Hudai unauthorized led troops into Yongkang county of Wuzhou, killing and plundering officials and people; when discovered, they pleaded service on campaign with the former emperor and begged commutation of death.

s0467.literal: An edict confiscated half their family property and exiled them after beating.
s0467.idiomatic: An edict confiscated half their family property and exiled them after beating.

s0468.literal: On xinmao day, notes were issued to relieve the poor of He Prefecture.
s0468.idiomatic: On xinmao day notes were issued to relieve the poor of He Prefecture.

s0469.literal: On yiwei day, a jade-green goblet was deposited in the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
s0469.idiomatic: On yiwei day a jade-green goblet was deposited in the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

s0470.literal: On bingshen day, the moon transgressed the western rampart general of the Supreme Palace Enclosure.
s0470.idiomatic: On bingshen day the moon transgressed the western rampart general of the Supreme Palace Enclosure.

s0471.literal: On xinchou day, because the month aligned with his personal fortune day, the Five Patriarchs Perfect Man Li Jushou was ordered to perform a jiao rite and submit a red memorial — five day-nights in all.
s0471.idiomatic: On xinchou day, because the month aligned with his personal fortune day, Five Patriarchs Perfect Man Li Jushou was ordered to perform a jiao rite and submit a red memorial for five day-nights.

s0472.literal: When the rite was complete, Jushou requested a private audience and said: "The crown prince is in the prime of youth — he should participate in state affairs."
s0472.idiomatic: When the rite was complete, Jushou requested a private audience and said: "The crown prince is in the prime of youth — he should participate in state affairs."

s0473.literal: The emperor said with pleasure: "That will come soon."
s0473.idiomatic: The emperor said with pleasure: "That will come soon."

s0474.literal: The next day, an edict was issued that Crown Prince Prince of Yan would participate in deciding court affairs; all matters of the Central Secretariat, Privy Council, Censorate, and the hundred offices were to be reported to him first, then to the emperor.
s0474.idiomatic: The next day an edict ordered Crown Prince Prince of Yan to participate in deciding court affairs; all matters of the Central Secretariat, Privy Council, Censorate, and the hundred offices were to be reported to him first, then to the emperor.

s0475.literal: On jiachen day, the King of Goryeo was granted the Zhiyuan seventeenth-year calendar.
s0475.idiomatic: On jiachen day the King of Goryeo received the Zhiyuan seventeenth-year calendar.

s0476.literal: Eleventh month, wushen day: an edict — robbers captured on various routes: first offense with large booty — death; second offense with small booty — lighter punishment.
s0476.idiomatic: Eleventh month, wushen day: an edict ordered that robbers captured on various routes — first offense with large booty — die; second offense with small booty — receive lighter punishment.

s0477.literal: Ahmad said: "There was a thief who exchanged old notes for one hundred forty ingots of new notes from the government treasury; deliberators said the crime should not warrant death — yet the thief's father serves in my household; if not punished according to law, how would he not fear?"
s0477.idiomatic: Ahmad said: "There was a thief who exchanged old notes for one hundred forty ingots of new notes from the government treasury; deliberators said the crime should not warrant death — yet the thief's father serves in my household; if not punished according to law, how would he not fear?"

s0479.literal: On renzi day, Minister of Rites Chai Chun was sent together with Annam envoy Trung Nhan to bear an edict instructing Annam heir Chen Nhat Hoang and demanding he come to court.
s0479.idiomatic: On renzi day Minister of Rites Chai Chun was sent with Annam envoy Trung Nhan to bear an edict instructing Annam heir Chen Nhat Hoang and demanding he come to court.

s0480.literal: On guichou day, the moon transgressed Mars.
s0480.idiomatic: On guichou day the moon transgressed Mars.

s0481.literal: On yimao day, newly enlisted troops of Taiyuan, Pingyang, Western Capital, and Yan'an circuits were disbanded and returned to their registers.
s0481.idiomatic: On yimao day newly enlisted troops of Taiyuan, Pingyang, Western Capital, and Yan'an circuits were disbanded and returned to their registers.

s0482.literal: The unregistered troops under pacification commissioner Liu Wannu who wished to follow the main army on campaign were disbanded.
s0482.idiomatic: The unregistered troops under pacification commissioner Liu Wannu who wished to follow the main army on campaign were disbanded.

s0483.literal: Zhao Bing reported that Shaanxi Transport Commission associate commissioner Guo and Prince Anxi's chancellery bureau director Guo Shuyun misappropriated government funds; an edict ordered Minister Toutuhu and supervising censor Guo You to inspect and verify.
s0483.idiomatic: Zhao Bing reported that Shaanxi Transport Commission associate commissioner Guo and Prince Anxi's chancellery bureau director Guo Shuyun misappropriated government funds; an edict ordered Minister Toutuhu and supervising censor Guo You to inspect and verify.

s0484.literal: On wuchen day, Hubei Circuit pacification commissioner Liu Shen was ordered to drill the newly submitted naval forces of Ezhou and Hanyang.
s0484.idiomatic: On wuchen day Hubei Circuit pacification commissioner Liu Shen was ordered to drill the newly submitted naval forces of Ezhou and Hanyang.

s0485.literal: An edict instructed the Sichuan Pacification Commission to register military and civilian household counts.
s0485.idiomatic: An edict instructed the Sichuan Pacification Commission to register military and civilian household counts.

s0486.literal: On jisi day, because Wuzhou sorcerer Wu Fashou incited the Longshui Yao barbarians of Teng Prefecture and Deqing Prefecture to rebel, his father was captured and executed.
s0486.idiomatic: On jisi day, because Wuzhou sorcerer Wu Fashou incited the Longshui Yao barbarians of Teng Prefecture and Deqing Prefecture to rebel, his father was captured and executed.

s0487.literal: The Music Bureau was merged into the Palace Guard Bureau.
s0487.idiomatic: The Music Bureau was merged into the Palace Guard Bureau.

s0488.literal: Twelfth month, wuyin day: grain and notes were issued to relieve poor salt-works households.
s0488.idiomatic: Twelfth month, wuyin day: grain and notes were issued to relieve poor salt-works households.

s0490.literal: On gengchen day, Annam presented tribute of medicinal materials.
s0490.idiomatic: On gengchen day Annam presented medicinal materials as tribute.

s0491.literal: On jiashen day, the sun was worshipped.
s0491.idiomatic: On jiashen day the sun was worshipped.

s0492.literal: On bingshen day, an edict ordered Privy Council and Hanlin Academy officials to join the Central Secretariat in deliberating with Suodu on attracting and submitting the various overseas fan.
s0492.idiomatic: On bingshen day an edict ordered Privy Council and Hanlin Academy officials to join the Central Secretariat in deliberating with Suodu on attracting and submitting the various overseas fan.

s0493.literal: On dingyou day, Baligai presented tribute of sea hawks.
s0493.idiomatic: On dingyou day Baligai presented sea hawks as tribute.

s0494.literal: Muslims and others, when passing through, had food supplied; they would not eat sheep unless self-slaughtered — the people suffered from this.
s0494.idiomatic: Muslims and others, when passing through, had food supplied but would not eat sheep unless self-slaughtered — the people suffered from this.

s0495.literal: The emperor said: "They are my slaves — how dare their diet not follow our dynasty's ways?"
s0495.idiomatic: The emperor said: "They are my slaves — how dare their diet not follow our dynasty's ways?"

s0497.literal: An edict instructed the rulers of various fan countries within and beyond the seas.
s0497.idiomatic: An edict instructed the rulers of various fan countries within and beyond the seas.

s0498.literal: Right censor Zhang Hui was granted five thousand four hundred taels of silver.
s0498.idiomatic: Right censor Zhang Hui received five thousand four hundred taels of silver.

s0499.literal: An edict: from the first day of the first month next year, jiao rites were to be established at Changchun Palace for seven days — to be made an annual precedent.
s0499.idiomatic: An edict ordered that from the first day of the first month next year jiao rites be established at Changchun Palace for seven days, to be made an annual precedent.

s0500.literal: Li Jushou was ordered to announce and sacrifice for the new year.
s0500.idiomatic: Li Jushou was ordered to announce and sacrifice for the new year.
